card.name: Provision words in laws and documents
card.fires_on: The word "provision(s)" or "clause" in legal or regulatory text, and similar document-content words like "contained" or "statement in" that come just before a description of what a text includes.

modes.description: Words such as "contained" or "in" that point to where information is found in a document.
